_note: THOROUGH torture suite - adversarial frontier, by category, split by WHICH ARM it tests. TWO families: (A) FRAME-SOLVABLE - homograph / multiword / similar_sounding / illogical_grammatical - structurally resolvable by the lexicon + selectional solver. (B) LLM-JUDGMENT - idiom / collective_noun / domain_sense / register - needs world-knowledge & fluency the frame layer does NOT encode; this is where a raw strong model is already the bar. The illogical_grammatical set is the anti-test: the selectional solver must disambiguate WITHOUT 'fixing' intentional anomalies. he<->en + niqqud; a native-speaker reviewer is ground truth.

items.trap: smikhut; NOT 'house of a book'.
NOT 'editor of law'.

items.gold_en: He noticed the door was open.
items.trap: שם לב = noticed, NOT 'put a heart'.
NOT 'exits a rib/wall'.
חבל על הזמן = 'amazing' OR 'waste of time'; here positive. idiom + polarity-by-context.

items.gold_en: All of this is an illusion.
items.trap: NOT 'holding of eyes'.

items.gold_en: His plan was a house of cards.
items.trap: ארמון חול literal 'sandcastle'; idiom = impressive thing that crumbles.
sin vs samekh flips hair<->storm.
ḥet vs kaf.
samekh vs shin.
sin/samekh/shin three-way on ש־כ־ר.
one vav.
he vs alef final.
grammatical, selectionally impossible. PRESERVE; do NOT fix. anti-test for the solver.

items.he: האבן הרזה בלעה את יום שלישי
items.trap: valid grammar, impossible semantics; preserve the absurdity.

items.he: השתיקה צבעה את המספר שבע בריח כחול
items.gold_en: The silence painted the number seven a blue smell.
items.trap: every selectional restriction violated, fully grammatical. faithfulness test.

items.he: מחר התחתן עם הזיכרון של אתמול
items.trap: time-as-agent; do not normalize.

items.gold_en: The stone's thirst sang a triangular song.
items.trap: שר=sang (homograph) inside an absurd frame - read it by grammar, but do NOT fix the impossible agent.

items.en: A flock of starlings wheeled over the marsh.
items.trap: flock of BIRDS = להקה, not עדר (herd, for cattle). pure model knowledge - frames don't encode collective-noun selection.

items.he: הנפח קירר את הפרסה הלוהטת במים
items.en: The blacksmith quenched the glowing horseshoe in water.
items.trap: metallurgical 'quench' = rapid COOLING, not 'extinguish' (כיבה). domain world-knowledge.

items.en: He kicked the bucket last winter.
items.trap: die, NOT literal kick+bucket. idiom faithfulness.
heavy rain, not literal.

items.en: She filed the report, then filed her nails.
items.gold_he: היא הגישה את הדוח, ואז ליטשה את ציפורניה
items.trap: two senses of 'file' in one sentence (submit / smooth).

items.en: The bark of the oak was rough.
items.trap: tree bark (קליפה), not dog-bark (נביחה). context-only.

items.en: The defendant was acquitted on a technicality.
items.trap: legal register: acquitted=זוכה, technicality=פגם פרוצדורלי/טכני. register + domain term.

items.en: A murder of crows settled on the roof.
items.trap: 'murder' here = a collective noun -> להקה; must NOT be רצח (homicide). literal head is a landmine. encodable as a collective-noun resource.

items.en: A pride of lions rested in the shade.
items.trap: 'pride' = collective -> להקה; NOT גאווה (vanity).

items.en: A school of fish darted past the reef.
items.gold_he: להקת דגים חלפה ליד שונית האלמוגים
items.trap: 'school' = collective -> להקה; NOT בית ספר.

items.en: A crash of rhinos thundered across the plain.
items.gold_he: עדר קרנפים שעט על פני המישור
items.trap: 'crash' = collective -> עדר; NOT התרסקות (collision).

items.en: A charm of finches scattered from the hedge.
items.gold_he: להקת פרושונים התפזרה מן הגדר החיה
items.trap: 'charm' = collective -> להקה; NOT קסם (magic).

items.en: A parliament of owls watched from the oak.
items.trap: 'parliament' = collective -> להקה; NOT פרלמנט (legislature).
Hebrew number GENDER-POLARITY: שלושה (the ה-ending one) goes with MASCULINE (ילדים); שלוש (bare) with FEMININE (ילדות) - the opposite of every other agreement.
ארבע (fem-looking) + women, ארבעה (masc-looking) + men. polarity holds 2-10.

items.gold_en: I bought a pair of shoes and new glasses
items.trap: נעליים / משקפיים are inherent DUALS (suffix ־יים), not plurals; 'pair' is built into the form; agreement is plural.

items.gold_en: I waited two days and maybe two weeks
items.trap: יומיים = 'two days', שבועיים = 'two weeks' - the dual encodes 'two X' in ONE word; not the plural 'days/weeks'.

items.he: ספרו היה על מדפו ליד ביתה
items.gold_en: His book was on his shelf next to her house
items.trap: possessive SUFFIXES fused to the noun: ספרו=his book, מדפו=his shelf, ביתה=her house. one letter (ו vs ה) flips his/her.

items.gold_en: I saw him and told him about her
items.trap: object + prepositional suffixes: ראיתיו = I-saw-him, לו = to-him, עליה = about-her - all single fused words.

items.gold_en: And when I arrived from the house in the village, I told him
items.trap: clitic stacks on one word: וכש = and-when, מה = from-the, שב = that-in. up to 5 prefixes (ו ש כ ל ב מ ה) must be peeled before the lemma.
smikhut definiteness: 'THE school' = בית הספר - the article sits on the 2ND word only, NOT הבית ספר. בֵּית is the construct form of בַּיִת.

items.gold_en: The Prime Minister of Israel gave a speech
items.trap: chained smikhut ראש->ממשלת->ישראל; ממשלה->ממשלת construct form; definiteness inherited from the last element.

items.gold_en: I used the computer and missed you
items.trap: idiomatic verb+preposition that does NOT map to English: השתמש בְּ (use+'in'), התגעגע אֶל (miss+'to'). pick the wrong prep -> ungrammatical.

items.he: ויתרתי על הכסף אבל שמרתי על הילד
items.gold_en: I gave up the money but watched over the child
items.trap: ויתר עַל / שמר עַל - same Hebrew prep על, two different English ('up' / 'over').

items.he: יש לי כלב אבל אין לי חתול
items.gold_en: I have a dog but I don't have a cat
items.trap: Hebrew has NO verb 'to have': possession = יש לְ (there-is to-me) / negated אין לְ. a literal 'have' fails.

items.gold_en: He is a doctor and she is a teacher
items.trap: no present-tense copula: הוא רופא = literally 'he doctor'. don't drop or mis-insert 'is'.

items.gold_en: He learned while the teacher taught
items.trap: one root ל-מ-ד, two binyanim: לָמַד (qal=learned) vs לִמֵּד (piel=taught). the pattern flips learn<->teach; bare למד/לימד differ by a single yod.

items.gold_en: The book was kept because I guarded it
items.trap: root ש-מ-ר: נִשְׁמַר (nifal=was kept, passive) vs שָׁמַרְתִּי (qal=I guarded). binyan carries voice + meaning at once.

both את identical bare: the FIRST is the definite-object MARKER (et - no meaning, untranslatable), the SECOND האת = 'the spade' (אֵת, a noun). also את = 'you'(fem, at). grammar-word vs noun homograph.

items.he: אכלתי את התפוח אבל לא תפוז
items.gold_en: I ate the apple but not an orange
items.trap: את appears ONLY before a DEFINITE object (התפוח), absent before the indefinite (תפוז). it has NO English word - never translate it.
same word, full (male, with vav) vs defective (haser) spelling - both correct. must NOT be treated as two different words.
defective spelling collides: מצות = מַצּוֹת (matzas) OR the ktiv-haser of מצוות (commandments). spelling variation manufactures a homograph.
שולחן is MASCULINE; plural שולחנות wears the fem-looking ־ות suffix, BUT the adjective is גדולים (masc) - agreement follows the noun's GENDER, not its suffix.
שנה is FEMININE; plural שנים wears the masc-looking ־ים suffix, but the adjective is רבות (fem). the suffix lies about gender. (cf. אב->אבות, איש->אנשים.)

items.gold_en: the road is long and the table is tall
items.trap: arbitrary grammatical gender: דרך is FEMININE (ארוכה), שולחן MASCULINE (גבוה). nothing semantic signals it - the adjective must agree with the memorized lexical gender.

items.gold_en: the sun is hot and the moon is full
items.trap: שמש FEMININE (חמה), ירח MASCULINE (מלא) - the reverse of many languages. lexical gender, not derivable.
the kamatz in כָּל is KAMATZ KATAN -> 'o' (kol), not the usual 'a'. closed unstressed syllable. a niqqud->phonetics engine reading it 'a' mispronounces.
first kamatz is katan: חָכְ = 'choch' (o), not 'chach'. identical niqqud to kamatz gadol; only syllable structure/stress disambiguates a<->o.

items.gold_en: The IDF operated on the northern border
items.trap: צה"ל = an acronym (צבא הגנה לישראל = IDF), marked by gershayim ("). read as a unit/expanded, NOT letter-by-letter and NOT as a quotation mark.
י"ד = the NUMBER 14 (yod=10 + dalet=4) in Hebrew letter-numerals, marked by gershayim. it is not a word. (cf. וכו' = etc., with a geresh.)

items.he: לא הלכתי, אין לי זמן, ואל תחכה לי
items.gold_en: I didn't go, I have no time, and don't wait for me
items.trap: three distinct negators: לא (didn't - verbal), אין (there-isn't - existential), אל (don't - prohibitive). English flattens to not/no/don't; Hebrew picks by context, and swapping them is ungrammatical.
אל תדאג = 'don't worry' (prohibitive command); לא תיכשל = 'you will not fail' (future). אל negates commands only - לא תדאג would mean 'you won't worry'.

items.gold_en: The writer is writing a letter
items.trap: כותב = both 'a writer' (agent noun) and 'writes/writing' (present-tense verb) - identical word. Hebrew present tense IS the participle; role is syntactic.

items.gold_en: The manager is running the meeting
items.trap: מנהל = 'manager' (noun) and 'manages/running' (verb), same form. (cf. שומר guard/guards, רוקד dancer/dances.)
